summary: Practise diagnosing performance gaps, coaching employees and documenting fair next steps. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Managing employee performance problems means identifying the cause of a work gap and agreeing proportionate next steps. For supervisors, team leads and HR practitioners, this course develops skills in diagnosing capability, resource and conduct concerns, building evidence timelines and setting SMART expectations. You’ll practise SBI feedback and GROW coaching, then draft improvement plans, review criteria and case records to support consistent follow-up.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits you if your role requires you to address an employee's repeated work gaps, difficult conduct or failure to meet agreed expectations. It is designed for people who need to act consistently, preserve useful evidence and involve HR at the right point.
prerequisites: You should have current or planned responsibility for supervising employees, advising managers or supporting employee relations. No coding or specialist software skills form part of the course exercises.
